displayedInputs.question: A basketball player makes 93 shots out of 150 attempts. Estimate the probability that he makes a shot (express the result as a decimal).

An opaque bag contains a total of 20 red and white balls, identical except for color. Each time, 1 ball is drawn, its color is recorded, and it is replaced. After a large number of repeated trials, the relative frequency of drawing a red ball is found to stabilize at 0.3. Estimate approximately how many red balls are in the bag.

Each of 2 people rolls a die. Player A wins if the sum of the numbers rolled is even, and Player B wins if it is odd. Is the game fair? (Give the probabilities of Player A and Player B winning, in that order, as fractions in simplest form, separated by a comma.)
Which of the following describes a game that is fair to both players?

choices.A: The numbers of participants on both sides are equal
choices.B: Both players have equal probabilities of winning
choices.C: Both players have a chance of winning
choices.D: The game always ends in a draw

displayedInputs.question: Two fair dice are rolled simultaneously. Player A wins if the sum is 7; Player B wins if the sum is 6 or 8; otherwise, neither player wins. How would you describe this game?

A bag contains 2 red balls and 1 white ball, identical except for color. Draw one ball, record its color, replace it, and then draw another ball. Player A wins if the two colors are the same; Player B wins if they are different. What is the probability that Player A wins? (Express your answer as a fraction in simplest form.)

The marking line of an angled parking space is 5 m long and forms an acute angle of \(60^\circ\) with the driving aisle. Approximately how many m of depth does the space occupy perpendicular to the driving aisle? (Use \(\sqrt{3}\approx1.73\). Round your answer to one decimal place.)
The marking line of an angled parking space is 6 m long and forms an acute angle of \(30^\circ\) with the driving aisle. How many m of depth does the space occupy perpendicular to the driving aisle?

Two adjacent marking lines of an angled parking space are parallel. The perpendicular distance between them (the parking space width) is 2.5 m, and the marking lines form an acute angle of \(30^\circ\) with the driving aisle. How many m of length does each space occupy along the driving aisle?

A site has only 4 m of depth perpendicular to the driving aisle, and the parking space marking lines are 5 m long. Which of the following parking angles (the acute angle between the marking lines and the driving aisle) allows the spaces to fit?

A 40 m stretch of roadside on one side of a driving aisle is available for parking spaces. Each space is 2.5 m wide (the perpendicular distance between adjacent marking lines). Each perpendicular parking space occupies 2.5 m along the roadside; the marking lines of angled parking spaces form an acute angle of \(30^\circ\) with the driving aisle. What is the maximum number of perpendicular spaces and angled spaces, respectively? (Answer in order, separated by a comma.)
A building model is made at a scale of \(1:100\). If the model is 0.35 m tall, how many m tall is the actual building?
A drawing has a scale of \(1:50\). A wall measures 8 cm on the drawing. What is its actual length in m?
A drawing has a scale of \(1:200\). A rectangular vacant lot measures 5 cm long and 3 cm wide on the drawing. What is its actual area in \(\text{m}^2\)?
A building model is made at a scale of \(1:100\) relative to the actual building. If the model's volume is \(0.02\text{ m}^3\), what is the actual building's volume in \(\text{m}^3\)?
To determine the germination rate of a new type of seed, which data collection method is appropriate: a questionnaire survey, an experiment, or consulting sources?
Which data collection method is most suitable for finding out the favorite extracurricular reading materials of all students in a class?
What is the most convenient and reliable method for learning how China's total population has changed over the past ten years?

choices.A: Consult official sources such as statistical yearbooks

displayedInputs.question: A questionnaire survey is used to find out how much time students spend playing games each day. Which of the following practices is most likely to bias the results?

choices.A: Have respondents complete the questionnaire anonymously
choices.B: Distribute the questionnaire randomly to students in different grades
choices.C: Use clearly defined, non-overlapping intervals for the questionnaire's response options
choices.D: Include the question “Don't you think playing games is a waste of time?”

displayedInputs.question: The favorite sports of 10 students are, in order: basketball, soccer, basketball, running, soccer, basketball, running, basketball, soccer, running. Organize the data into a statistical table. How many students favor basketball, soccer, and running, respectively? (Answer in order, separated by commas.)

When tallying, one complete five-stroke “zheng” character represents 5. The tally for a category consists of 2 complete “zheng” characters plus 3 additional strokes. How many data values are in this category?
A group of 40 students is classified by favorite color. The tallies show 15 for red, 12 for blue, and 10 for green, while the total is recorded as 40. Which statement is correct?

choices.A: The table is correct, and the total is accurate
choices.B: Changing the total to 37 will make the table correct
choices.C: The sum of the three category counts is 37, which does not match 40. This indicates omitted or incorrectly recorded data that need to be checked again

displayedInputs.question: Divide 20 data values into 3 categories: no greater than 10, 11 to 20 (including 20), and greater than 20. The data values, in order, are: 8, 12, 25, 10, 17, 21, 5, 14, 30, 19, 11, 9, 22, 16, 13, 28, 7, 18, 24, 15. How many belong to the 11 to 20 category?

The precipitation amounts at a certain location for months 1 to 4 are 20, 35, 55, and 40 (mm), respectively. When these are plotted on a line graph, between which 2 adjacent months is the increase greatest?

A bar chart is being drawn for precipitation at a certain location. The maximum data value is 55 (mm), and the vertical axis starts at 0, with each division representing 10 mm. What is the minimum number of divisions needed on the vertical axis to accommodate the maximum value?
To draw a bar chart for the data values 120, 350, 280, and 410, which vertical axis scale is most suitable?
A line graph shows sales volumes (items) for months 1 to 5 as 18, 30, 24, 40, and 46, respectively. How many items is the difference between the maximum and minimum values?

In a pie chart, a category accounts for 25% of the total. What is its corresponding central angle in degrees? If this category contains 30 people, what is the total number of people? (Answer in order, separated by a comma; write only numbers.)
In a pie chart, a category accounts for 40% of the total. What is its corresponding central angle in degrees?
A class surveys 80 people, of whom 18 like music. When drawing a pie chart, what is the central angle in degrees corresponding to the category of people who like music?
The central angles of 3 sectors in a pie chart are in the ratio \(1:2:3\). What percentage of the total does the largest sector account for? (Enter only the number, without %.)
The values of 2 bars are 49 and 51, respectively, but the vertical axis starts at 48, making the second bar appear 3 times as tall as the first. What makes this chart misleading?

choices.B: The vertical axis is truncated to start at 48, exaggerating the difference between the 2 values

displayedInputs.question: To prevent a bar chart from being misleading, its vertical axis should generally

choices.A: Start at any arbitrarily chosen value, as long as it looks good
choices.B: Have scale intervals that vary in size to emphasize key points
choices.C: Start at 0 and have evenly spaced scale intervals

displayedInputs.question: The values of 2 bars are 80 and 100, respectively, and the vertical axis starts at 70. How many times as tall as the first bar is the second bar in the chart?

Sales revenues are 200 and 250, respectively, in units of ten thousand yuan, and the vertical axis starts at 150 in the same units. How many times as tall as the first bar is the second bar in the chart? How many times the first value is the actual second value? (Answer in order, separated by a comma, and write the answers as decimals.)

40 data values are divided into 4 groups, with frequencies of 6, 14, 12, and 8, respectively. What is the relative frequency of each group? (Answer in order, separated by commas, and write the answers as decimals.)
In a frequency distribution table, the sum of the relative frequencies of all groups equals

choices.C: The total number of data values

displayedInputs.question: There are 80 data values in total, and the relative frequency of a certain group is 0.35. What is the frequency of this group?

60 data values are divided into 5 groups. The frequencies of the first 4 groups are 6, 15, 21, and 12, respectively. What is the relative frequency of the fifth group? (Write the answer as a decimal.)
To select 5 students from 50 students numbered 1 to 50, how should the method of drawing lots be carried out? Which of the following procedures is correct?

choices.A: Have the teacher choose 5 students considered representative
choices.B: Directly select the students numbered 1 to 5
choices.C: Write only the numbers 1 to 10 on slips of paper and draw 5 slips
choices.D: Write each of the 50 numbers on a separate slip of paper of the same size and shape, mix them thoroughly, and randomly draw 5 slips
